title: Dachshund Apocalypse Ritual
description: A surreal green and orange dachshund stands in the center wearing a crown of thorns with pink flowers, its eyes dripping pink liquid. It is positioned before a massive cracked stone tablet covered in glowing green runes, with a cracked egg containing a woman's face on the ground to the right, set against a dystopian industrial background with smokestacks and a pink toxic sky.
prompt: A surreal apocalyptic scene featuring a green and orange dachshund standing upright with dripping pink liquid from its eyes and mouth, wearing a crown of thorns adorned with pink flowers. The dog stands before a massive cracked ancient stone tablet covered in glowing green runes. A cracked egg with a woman's face inside rests on the ground surrounded by ritual circles and bones. Dystopian industrial factories with black smoke fill the background under a swirling pink and black toxic sky with falling petals.
